verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
It doesn't matter where I run
You're there for me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
It doesn't matter what I've done
Your love's for me

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
You wipe away the tears
You lift me when I fall

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines: My life is safe by the mercy of Your grace

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
It doesn't matter where I go
You walk with me

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
It doesn't matter when I fall
You cover me

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You are my Father, Provider
You're my Deliverer

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Your mercies embrace me, surround me
Through Your everlasting love

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Father I worship You
Father I worship You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
And Your love is for me X2
And Your love is forever
